description: This file defines classes and structs for executing concurrent load generation and performance measurement in a distributed testing environment, specifically targeting client-side load scenarios. It includes the LoadGeneratorReport struct and the ConcurrentLoadGenerator<TState> class, which manage workload creation, timing, and reporting.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorReport
classes.description: A struct representing a summary report of load testing metrics such as completed requests, successes, failures, total duration, and a string representation for easy display.

classes.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of concurrent load requests, orchestrating multiple worker tasks, collecting metrics, and generating performance reports.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator.Warmup
methods.description: Prepares the load generator by running warmup requests and discarding warmup measurements.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator.ResetBetweenRuns
methods.description: Initializes or resets the internal channel used for recording completed work blocks between test runs.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator.Run
methods.description: Executes the load test asynchronously, managing worker lifecycle, progress reporting, and final report generation.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator.BuildReport
methods.description: Aggregates the collected work blocks to produce a summary performance report.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator.RunWorker
methods.description: Performs the workload by issuing requests in a loop until the specified number of blocks is completed or the cancellation token is triggered.
